arguments.command:
python -c "
import humanize

# Test various metric values
print('Testing metric function:')
test_cases = [
    (0, '0.0'),
    (1, '1.0'),
    (500, '500.0'),
    (1000, '1.0k'),
    (5000, '5.0k'),
    (1230000, '1.2M'),
    (1234567890, '1.2G'),
    (-5000, '-5.0k'),
    (0.001, '1.0m'),
    (0.000001, '1.0μ'),
    (0.000000001, '1.0n'),
    (0.000000000001, '1.0p'),
    (0.000000000000001, '1.0f'),
    (0.000000000000000001, '1.0a'),
]

for value, expected in test_cases:
    result = humanize.metric(value)
    status = '✓' if result == expected else f'✗ (got {result!r})'
    print(f'  metric({value}) = {result!r} {status}')

# Test with ndigits parameter
print('\nTesting metric with ndigits:')
print(f'  metric(1230000, ndigits=0) = {humanize.metric(1230000, ndigits=0)!r}')
print(f'  metric(1230000, ndigits=2) = {humanize.metric(1230000, ndigits=2)!r}')
print(f'  metric(1230000, ndigits=None) = {humanize.metric(1230000, ndigits=None)!r}')
"
